verdict.rationale: Shopify's APIs are GraphQL, and its first-party AI Toolkit connects AI coding tools to 'API schemas' and validates queries against Shopify schemas. That is an equivalent machine-readable spec channel, but the evidence does not document a direct downloadable schema file (SDL or introspection JSON), and probes found no OpenAPI document at the standard paths. GraphiQL is an in-browser query tool, not a spec download, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented direct download of the GraphQL schema/spec file, explicit spec format and versioned download URLs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Shopify AI Toolkit connects your AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs, API schemas, and CLI store management so they can help you build more accurately.
The toolkit connects your agent to: Developer docs and API schemas
